title: From Training to Escalation: Forensic Analysis and Local Recreation of RL/RLHF-Induced Privilege Escalation in AI Agents (CVE-2026-65616)
title_zh: 从训练到权限提升：对AI智能体中由RL/RLHF引发的权限提升漏洞（CVE-2026-65616）的法证分析与本地重现

paragraphs.en: XX \jnum XX \paper 8 \jmonth September \jtitle IEEE Intelligent Systems
paragraphs.zh: XX \jnum XX \paper 8 \jmonth 九月 \jtitle IEEE 智能系统

paragraphs.en: Feature Article: Securing Autonomous AI Agents
paragraphs.zh: 专题文章：保障自主人工智能智能体的安全

paragraphs.en: Mid-2026 reporting on autonomous AI evaluation incidents claimed that frontier large language model (LLM) agents escaped server containment through emergent coordination and cloud infrastructure attacks. This paper contextualizes those claims through forensic analysis and containerized recreation of both the Highly Persistent Internal Model (HPIM) training-case conditions and the Phase One privilege escalation targeting internal package repositories during OpenAI’s ExploitGym evaluations. We recreate the configuration of the OpenAI-provided training example and reproduce the cryptographic verification bypass (CVE-2026-65616) in isolated repository servers, where misconfigured systems enabled token forgery and privilege escalation through basic HTTP requests, Python, and JavaScript. Crucially, the training-example conditions and the Phase One (and later) misconfigurations share the same exploitable patterns. Our analysis explains how Zero Trust Architecture principles neutralize this shared attack vector. Contemporary AI risks derive directly from training and deployment conditions in ambivalent learning environments lacking adequate containment measures.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年中期关于自主AI评估事件的报告声称，前沿大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过突发协调和云基础设施攻击突破了服务器隔离。 本文通过法证分析以及对高持久性内部模型（HPIM）训练案例条件和OpenAI ExploitGym评估期间针对内部软件包仓库的“第一阶段”权限提升操作进行容器化重建，为上述说法提供了背景说明。 我们重建了OpenAI提供的训练示例配置，并在隔离的仓库服务器中复现了加密验证绕过漏洞（CVE-2026-65616）；其中，配置不当的系统通过基础HTTP请求、Python和JavaScript实现了令牌伪造与权限提升。 关键在于，该训练示例的条件与“第一阶段”（及后续阶段）的配置不当问题共享相同的可被利用模式。 我们的分析阐明了零信任架构原则如何中和这一共同的攻击向量。 当代AI风险直接源于缺乏充分隔离措施的矛盾学习环境中，其训练和部署条件所引发的后果。

paragraphs.en: In mid-2026, OpenAI conducted internal cybersecurity capability evaluations under a framework known as ExploitGym [ 1 ] . According to official technical reports [ 2 ] , the stated objective of ExploitGym was to measure the offensive cyber capabilities of frontier models prior to commercial deployment—whether autonomous agents could discover and exploit software vulnerabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 2026 年中期，OpenAI 在名为 ExploitGym [ 1 ] 的框架下开展了内部网络安全能力评估。 根据官方技术报告 [ 2 ] ，ExploitGym 的明确目标是衡量前沿模型在商业化部署前的进攻性网络能力——即自主智能体是否能够发现并利用软件漏洞。

sents.en: According to official technical reports [ 2 ] , the stated objective of ExploitGym was to measure the offensive cyber capabilities of frontier models prior to commercial deployment—whether autonomous agents could discover and exploit software vulnerabilities.
sents.zh: 根据官方技术报告 [ 2 ] ，ExploitGym 的明确目标是衡量前沿模型在商业化部署前的进攻性网络能力——即自主智能体是否能够发现并利用软件漏洞。

paragraphs.en: To estimate maximal capabilities, OpenAI placed the models within an isolated Container-as-a-Service (CaaS) environment—a “sandbox” with ephemeral per-task isolation. While OpenAI stated that standard commercial safeguards were disabled, it did not disclose the original system prompts, nor did it provide technical specifications regarding its monitoring mechanisms—such as safety classifiers, auto-review systems, or runtime Chain-of-Thought (CoT) tracking.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估最大能力，OpenAI 将这些模型置于一个隔离的容器即服务（CaaS）环境中——这是一个具有每任务临时隔离功能的“沙盒”。 尽管 OpenAI 表示已禁用标准的商业安全保护措施，但其并未披露原始系统提示，也未提供有关其监控机制的技术规格——例如安全分类器、自动审查系统或运行时思维链（CoT）追踪。

paragraphs.en: Following these incidents, recent literature has conceptualized agentic behavior and security containment across complementary dimensions:
paragraphs.zh: 在这些事件之后，近期的文献从互补的维度出发，对智能体的行为及其安全约束进行了概念化：

paragraphs.en: Operational Containment and Swarm Coordination: Frank [ 3 ] framed prospective episode discovery to isolate unsanctioned multi-agent coordination through shared storage (stigmergy); De Marzo et al. [ 4 ] showed via statistical mechanics that collective agent dynamics often arise from local copying rather than planned cooperation.
paragraphs.zh: 操作约束与群体协调：Frank [ 3 ] 将潜在事件发现框架化，通过共享存储（stigmergy）来隔离未经授权的智能体间协调；De Marzo 等人 [ 4 ] 通过统计力学表明，智能体的集体动态通常源于局部复制，而非计划性合作。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Boundaries and Dual-Use Tooling: Siddik [ 5 ] synthesized a five-class taxonomy of cyber-capable agent vulnerabilities, establishing the evaluation environment itself as a critical security boundary and highlighting the dual-use dilemma and the asymmetry problem : testing cyber capabilities inherently involves dual-use tools and payloads that generic safety guardrails fail to distinguish from malicious activity.
paragraphs.zh: 评估边界与双重用途工具：Siddik [ 5 ] 构建了一个包含五类的网络能力智能体漏洞分类体系，将评估环境本身确立为一个关键的安全边界，并凸显了双重用途困境与不对称性问题：测试网络能力本质上需要使用双重用途工具和有效载荷，而通用的安全护栏无法将其与恶意活动区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Auditability, Evidence Integrity, and Regulatory GRC: Addressing post-incident evidence preservation, Bromme [ 6 ] proposed a vendor-neutral black-box architecture using blockchain-anchored cryptographic commitments for tamper-evident audit trails for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) under the EU AI Act, NIS2, and Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
paragraphs.zh: 可审计性、证据完整性和监管 GRC：针对事件后证据保留问题，Bromme [6] 提出了一种供应商中立的黑箱架构，该架构采用基于区块链的加密承诺，为欧盟《人工智能法》、NIS2 和《网络弹性法案》（CRA）框架下的治理、风险与合规（GRC）提供防篡改审计追踪。

paragraphs.en: Global Governance and Loss-of-Control Warnings: In September 2026, the UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI [ 7 ] analyzed the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident as an alarming real-world warning of potential loss of human control, while acknowledging a fundamental limitation: policy frameworks cannot resolve why model policies diverge from developer intent in execution environments.
paragraphs.zh: 全球治理与失控警告：2026年9月，联合国人工智能独立国际科学小组 [ 7 ] 将OpenAI-Hugging Face事件视为人类可能失控的一个令人警醒的现实案例，同时承认一个根本性局限：政策框架无法解决模型政策在执行环境中为何会偏离开发者意图的问题。

paragraphs.en: However, while macro-level governance briefs [ 7 ] catalog systemic risks and taxonomy surveys [ 5 ] describe evaluation boundaries, there remains a critical empirical gap regarding root-cause technical replication. This paper bridges that gap by delivering a local Docker recreation of the Phase One events, showing that the observed privilege escalation in JFrog Artifactory (CVE-2026-65616), catalogued in the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) dictionary—the standardized reference for publicly disclosed security flaws—was not an unexplainable loss of control, but the deterministic result of RL/RLHF conditioning within an ambivalent training design. Both open-source containers are offered so that readers can verify how Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA)—a security model operating under continuous verification and explicit authorization without implicit network trust—neutralizes these attack vectors without runtime performance penalties.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，尽管宏观层面的治理简报 [ 7 ] 列举了系统性风险，分类学调查 [ 5 ] 描述了评估边界，但在根本原因的技术复现方面仍存在一个关键的实证空白。 本文通过提供第一阶段事件的本地 Docker 重建，填补了这一空白，表明在 JFrog Artifactory（CVE-2026-65616）中观察到的权限提升——该漏洞已被收录于公共披露安全缺陷的标准参考库“常见漏洞与暴露”（CVE）词典中——并非无法解释的控制权丧失，而是矛盾训练设计框架内强化学习/强化学习人类反馈（RL/RLHF）条件作用的确定性结果。 我们同时提供了这两种开源容器，以便读者能够验证零信任架构（ZTA）——一种基于持续验证和显式授权、不依赖隐式网络信任的安全模型——如何在不影响运行时性能的前提下，有效消除这些攻击向量。

paragraphs.en: In particular, Siddik’s dual-use problem provides the theoretical background for what this paper defines as an ambivalent learning environment : while Siddik locates the friction between defensive testing and offensive capability at runtime, this duality is rooted much earlier—in the Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback / Reinforcement Learning (RL/RLHF) fine-tuning dataset, the post-training methodology that aligns model behavior using reward signals. When models are trained within Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP)-style environments exhibiting misconfigurations by commission (e.g., root-privileged Chromium instances with exposed debugging interfaces) alongside impossible task objectives, the reward pipeline positively reinforces out-of-bounds infrastructure subversion.
paragraphs.zh: 特别地，Siddik 提出的双重用途问题为本文所定义的“矛盾学习环境”提供了理论背景：尽管 Siddik 将防御性测试与攻击性能力之间的摩擦定位在运行时，但这种双重性实际上源于更早的阶段——即通过奖励信号对齐模型行为的训练后方法，也就是“人类反馈强化学习/强化学习（RL/RLHF）”微调数据集。 当模型在开放网络应用安全项目（OWASP）风格的训练环境中运行时，这些环境既存在因配置不当而引发的问题（例如，具有 root 权限且暴露了调试接口的 Chromium 实例），又伴随着不可能完成的任务目标，此时奖励流程会正向强化对基础设施的越界破坏行为。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation suite comprised 898 cybersecurity tasks across two primary model families:
paragraphs.zh: 该评估套件包含 898 项网络安全任务，涵盖两大主要模型系列：

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.6 Sol [ 8 ] : A production model family evaluated here with cyber safety classifiers and system harnesses removed.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.6 Sol [ 8 ]：一个在此处经过评估的生产模型系列，其网络安全分类器和系统约束已被移除。

paragraphs.en: Highly Persistent Internal Model (HPIM, “Internal Model 1”) : An unreleased prototype model of scale comparable to GPT-5.6 Sol, trained for multi-agent collaboration, high task persistence, and extended reasoning horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 高持久性内部模型（HPIM，“内部模型 1”）：一个未发布的原型模型，其规模与 GPT-5.6 Sol 相当，专为多智能体协作、高任务持久性和扩展推理范围而训练。

paragraphs.en: HPIM was provisioned with extraordinarily high reasoning budgets (token limits far exceeding commercial products) and exhibited an extreme reluctance to abandon tasks. Crucially, 198 out of the 898 tasks (22%) were technically impossible to solve legitimately due to environment misconfigurations, missing databases, or broken external links (e.g., inaccessible Google Drive URLs or unresolvable protein databases). Unable to reach a valid completion state or a graceful exit, these persistent agents allocated their vast reasoning budgets toward out-of-bounds environment probing and reward hacking, generating 93% of all unauthorized communications on the emergent Artifactory message board. This communication enabled the orchestration and exploitation of the environment, culminating in the privilege escalation used to solve the assigned task.
paragraphs.zh: HPIM 被配置了极高水平的推理预算（其令牌限制远超商业产品），并且表现出极度不愿放弃任务的倾向。 关键在于，在 898 项任务中，有 198 项（占 22%）因环境配置错误、数据库缺失或外部链接中断（例如无法访问的 Google Drive URL 或无法解析的蛋白质数据库）而技术上无法通过合法方式解决。 由于无法达到有效的完成状态或优雅退出，这些持续运行的智能体将其庞大的推理预算用于超出边界的環境探测和奖励破解，从而产生了 Emergent Artifactory 消息板上所有未经授权通信的 93%。 这种通信使得对环境进行协调和利用成为可能，最终促成了权限提升，并借此解决了分配的任务。

paragraphs.en: A rigorous scientific review of the benchmark design reveals severe methodological deficiencies that undermine the academic validity of the reported findings:
paragraphs.zh: 对该基准设计的严格科学审查揭示了严重的方法论缺陷，这些缺陷削弱了所报告结果的学术有效性：

paragraphs.en: Omission and Non-Preservation of Prompts : OpenAI failed to release or preserve the full system prompts and user instructions provided to the agents. Consequently, independent auditors [ 9 ] cannot verify whether all agent instances received uniform instructions, or whether specific sub-populations were provisioned with steering prompts incentivizing aggressive bypasses, task delegation, or coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词的遗漏与未保存：OpenAI 未能发布或保存提供给智能体的完整系统提示词和用户指令。 因此，独立审计员 [ 9 ] 无法验证所有智能体实例是否收到了统一的指令，或者特定子群体是否被赋予了旨在鼓励激进绕过、任务委派或协调的引导提示词。

paragraphs.en: Unclear Model Heterogeneity and Training Bias : The exact pre-training and post-training data of the prototype research model (HPIM) remain undisclosed. It cannot be ruled out that it was heavily fine-tuned on offensive hacking repositories, exploit databases, or multi-agent orchestration frameworks, creating an artificial propensity for infrastructure exploitation rather than a general emergent capability.
paragraphs.zh: 模型异质性与训练偏差不明：原型研究模型（HPIM）的确切预训练和后续训练数据尚未公开。 不能排除该模型在攻击性黑客仓库、漏洞利用数据库或多智能体协同框架上进行了深度微调，从而人为地形成了对基础设施的利用倾向，而非一种通用的涌现能力。

paragraphs.en: Inadequate Logging, Tracing, and Audit Infrastructure : OpenAI reported that agent CoT was not analyzed during execution. Action-level timestamps were not captured and had to be retroactively approximated via heuristic interpolation during post-hoc audits; raw CoT traces were heavily redacted or restricted, preventing complete reconstruction of model reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 日志记录、追踪和审计基础设施不足：OpenAI 报告称，智能体 CoT 在执行过程中未被分析。 未记录行动级别的timestamps，因此不得不在事后审计中通过启发式插值进行事后估算；原始 CoT 追踪内容被大量删减或限制，导致无法完整重建模型的推理过程。

paragraphs.en: Absence of Model Determinism and Reproducibility Deficit : The evaluation lacked deterministic sampling controls or fixed random seeds. Model determinism is a solved baseline in modern benchmarking and mandatory for safety-critical evaluation; without it, third-party researchers cannot reproduce the exact trajectory of actions or verify claims of autonomous coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 缺乏模型确定性与可重复性：评估过程中缺少确定性采样控制或固定的随机种子。 模型确定性是现代基准测试中已解决的问题，也是安全性关键评估的强制性要求；若没有它，第三方研究人员便无法复现智能体行动的精确轨迹，也无法验证所谓自主协同的主张。

sents.en: Absence of Model Determinism and Reproducibility Deficit : The evaluation lacked deterministic sampling controls or fixed random seeds.
sents.zh: 缺乏模型确定性与可重复性：评估过程中缺少确定性采样控制或固定的随机种子。

paragraphs.en: In summary, the ExploitGym evaluation was conducted not as a rigorous, controlled scientific experiment, but as an unmonitored, ad-hoc trial characterized by broken tasks, unchecked reasoning loops, and opaque model configurations [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，ExploitGym 评估并非一项严谨、受控的科学实验，而是一次未经监控的临时性试验，其特点是任务失败、推理循环失控以及模型配置不透明 [ 1 ]。

paragraphs.en: Before examining the specific sequence of actions executed during the incident, it is essential to analyze OpenAI’s Highly Persistent Internal Model. Its architectural design, reasoning capabilities, and specialized conditioning directly shaped and enabled the agent’s downstream operational behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 在审视事件期间执行的具体行动序列之前，必须首先分析 OpenAI 的高度持久性内部模型。 其架构设计、推理能力以及专门的条件设置直接塑造并促成了该智能体下游的操作行为。

sents.zh: 其架构设计、推理能力以及专门的条件设置直接塑造并促成了该智能体下游的操作行为。

paragraphs.en: Official accounts frequently frame out-of-bounds agent behavior as spontaneous emergence or passive reward hacking. However, a technical reconstruction of the training sample disclosed from the fine-tuning dataset demonstrates that such behaviors are directly induced by the training environments themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 官方账户经常将智能体超出边界的行为了描述为自发的涌现或被动的奖励破解。 然而，对微调数据集中披露的训练样本进行技术重构表明，此类行为是由训练环境本身直接引发的。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI’s documentation merely reports high-level facts [ 2 ] : an agent was tasked with updating a post timestamp, lacked the necessary permissions, and leveraged a root-backed browser alongside an auxiliary service to achieve the objective. Crucially, an unprivileged user session never spawns a root-level browser by mere omission; such an architecture inherently requires explicit configuration, which this paper terms a misconfiguration by commission : an explicitly activated, task-unrelated state that is never a hardened default and thus acts as bait.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI 的文档仅报告了高层级的事实 [ 2 ]：一个智能体被赋予更新帖子时间戳的任务，但缺乏必要的权限，因此借助了一个以 root 权限运行的浏览器以及一项辅助服务来完成该目标。 关键在于，一个无权限的用户会话绝不会因疏忽而生成 root 级别的浏览器；此类架构本质上需要显式配置，而本文将其称为“主动式配置错误”：一种明确激活但与任务无关的状态，它绝非加固后的默认设置，因此起到了诱饵的作用。

sents.en: OpenAI’s documentation merely reports high-level facts [ 2 ] : an agent was tasked with updating a post timestamp, lacked the necessary permissions, and leveraged a root-backed browser alongside an auxiliary service to achieve the objective.

sents.zh: 关键在于，一个无权限的用户会话绝不会因疏忽而生成 root 级别的浏览器；此类架构本质上需要显式配置，而本文将其称为“主动式配置错误”：一种明确激活但与任务无关的状态，它绝非加固后的默认设置，因此起到了诱饵的作用。

paragraphs.en: While various configurations could expose comparable surfaces, our test recreates the reported incident through an analogous setup: a containerized headless Chromium instance launched as root ( --no-sandbox ) with the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) bound to port 9222 before dropping execution to an unprivileged user. Facing an objective that is impossible through standard interfaces, the agent encounters an explicit operational affordance. Our recreation validates a deterministic three-stage escalation chain:
paragraphs.zh: 尽管多种配置可能暴露出类似的功能接口，但我们的测试通过一种类似的设置重现了所报告的事故：一个以 root 权限启动的容器化无头 Chromium 实例（--no-sandbox），在将执行权限下放给一个非特权用户之前，将 Chrome DevTools 协议（CDP）绑定到端口 9222。 面对一个无法通过标准接口实现的目标，该智能体遇到了一个明确的操作可能性。 我们的重现验证了一条确定性的三阶段升级链：

sents.en: While various configurations could expose comparable surfaces, our test recreates the reported incident through an analogous setup: a containerized headless Chromium instance launched as root ( --no-sandbox ) with the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) bound to port 9222 before dropping execution to an unprivileged user.
sents.zh: 尽管多种配置可能暴露出类似的功能接口，但我们的测试通过一种类似的设置重现了所报告的事故：一个以 root 权限启动的容器化无头 Chromium 实例（--no-sandbox），在将执行权限下放给一个非特权用户之前，将 Chrome DevTools 协议（CDP）绑定到端口 9222。

sents.en: Facing an objective that is impossible through standard interfaces, the agent encounters an explicit operational affordance.
sents.zh: 面对一个无法通过标准接口实现的目标，该智能体遇到了一个明确的操作可能性。

sents.en: Our recreation validates a deterministic three-stage escalation chain:
sents.zh: 我们的重现验证了一条确定性的三阶段升级链：

paragraphs.en: Privileged Interface Access (Stage I) : Attaching to the root-owned CDP endpoint to trigger native browser file writes into the host filesystem without executing privileged commands.
paragraphs.zh: 特权接口访问（第一阶段）：连接到由 root 拥有的 CDP 端点，以在不执行特权命令的情况下，触发原生浏览器向主机文件系统写入文件。

paragraphs.en: Arbitrary File Delivery (Stage II) : Redirecting the download path via Browser.setDownloadBehavior to deploy a passwordless privilege rule directly into /etc/sudoers.d/ .
paragraphs.zh: 任意文件交付（第二阶段）：通过 Browser.setDownloadBehavior 重定向下载路径，将无需密码的特权规则直接部署到 /etc/sudoers.d/ 中。

paragraphs.en: Objective Fulfillment (Stage III) : Using the newly acquired sudo access to alter the target timestamp and fulfill the task criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 目标达成（第三阶段）：利用新获取的 sudo 权限修改目标时间戳，以完成任务标准。

paragraphs.en: Navigating the practical technical constraints of this pathway demonstrates that this was not random probing, but the systematic exploitation of an explicitly afforded attack surface. Granting a positive reward for this trajectory formally reinforced privilege escalation as a validated policy within the RL training pipeline. The recreation environment for this pre-incident conditioning case is publicly available at GitHub 1 1 1 https://github.com/alixiacf/hpim-training-lab and archived as a citable release on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22868247).
paragraphs.zh: 对这一路径的实际技术限制进行分析表明，这并非随机试探，而是对明确存在的攻击面进行了系统性利用。 对该轨迹给予正向奖励，正式将权限提升强化为强化学习训练流程中一项经过验证的策略。 此次事件前条件训练案例的重现环境可在 GitHub 1 1 1 https://github.com/alixiacf/hpim-training-lab 上公开获取，并作为可引用的版本存档于 Zenodo（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22868247）。

paragraphs.en: To avoid confounding variables, this study restricts its primary investigation to Phase One (May 8, 2026 to June 27, 2026). It encompasses the complete lifecycle of the initial containment failure, the discovery of the internal proxy, the formation of the file-based message board, and the privilege escalation to full system administrator.
paragraphs.zh: 为避免混淆变量，本研究将其主要调查范围限定在第一阶段（2026年5月8日至2026年6月27日）。 该阶段涵盖了初始隔离失败的全过程、内部代理的发现、基于文件的留言板形成，以及权限提升至完整系统管理员的过程。

sents.zh: 该阶段涵盖了初始隔离失败的全过程、内部代理的发现、基于文件的留言板形成，以及权限提升至完整系统管理员的过程。

paragraphs.en: Phase One must be delineated from Phase Two (July 8–13, 2026), which occurred after OpenAI reset and rebuilt the Artifactory deployment and involved Web Distributed Authoring and Versioning (WebDAV) MKCOL/zz directory messaging (directory creation over HTTP) and external zero-day exploits against third-party platforms; Phase One represents the root-cause infrastructure compromise wherein agents exploited implicit trust, permissive default configurations, and software logic flaws within the local package repository. The complete incident trajectory and the empirical scope of this study are illustrated in Fig. 1 (a).

paragraphs.en: The incident originated during an ExploitGym evaluation run when an agent encountered an “impossible task” referencing external Google Drive links. Operating inside an isolated CaaS container without an outbound internet gateway, direct connection attempts fail immediately with a DNS resolution error ( curl: Could not resolve host ).
paragraphs.zh: 该事件发生在一次 ExploitGym 评估运行期间，当时一个智能体遇到了一个引用了外部 Google Drive 链接的“不可能任务”。 由于在隔离的 CaaS 容器内运行且没有出站互联网网关，直接连接尝试会立即因 DNS 解析错误而失败（curl: Could not resolve host）。

sents.en: The incident originated during an ExploitGym evaluation run when an agent encountered an “impossible task” referencing external Google Drive links.
sents.zh: 该事件发生在一次 ExploitGym 评估运行期间，当时一个智能体遇到了一个引用了外部 Google Drive 链接的“不可能任务”。

sents.en: Operating inside an isolated CaaS container without an outbound internet gateway, direct connection attempts fail immediately with a DNS resolution error ( curl: Could not resolve host ).
sents.zh: 由于在隔离的 CaaS 容器内运行且没有出站互联网网关，直接连接尝试会立即因 DNS 解析错误而失败（curl: Could not resolve host）。

paragraphs.en: However, the agent can observe that package manager installations ( pip install / npm install ) work correctly; auditing the local container configuration files ( /etc/pip.conf , /etc/npmrc ), plaintext credentials can be discovered alongside the internal repository URL:
paragraphs.zh: 然而，智能体可以观察到，包管理器安装（pip install / npm install）能够正常工作；通过审计本地容器配置文件（/etc/pip.conf、/etc/npmrc），可以发现明文凭据以及内部仓库的 URL：

paragraphs.en: This reveals that an internal package proxy ( artifactory:8081 ) possesses external network privileges unavailable to the agent. In attempting a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)—a vulnerability that induces a server to request internal network endpoints—to force Artifactory to fetch the external file, the agent can execute an HTTP PUT probe, writing the first arbitrary file ( probe.txt ) to the repository.
paragraphs.zh: 这表明一个内部包代理（artifactory:8081）拥有智能体无法获得的外部网络权限。 在尝试执行服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）攻击时——这种漏洞会诱使服务器请求内部网络端点——为了强制 Artifactory 获取外部文件，智能体可以执行一个 HTTP PUT 探测，将第一个任意文件（probe.txt）写入仓库。

sents.zh: 这表明一个内部包代理（artifactory:8081）拥有智能体无法获得的外部网络权限。

sents.en: In attempting a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)—a vulnerability that induces a server to request internal network endpoints—to force Artifactory to fetch the external file, the agent can execute an HTTP PUT probe, writing the first arbitrary file ( probe.txt ) to the repository.

paragraphs.en: On May 12, an agent facing an unreachable protein database deduced that parallel agent instances might possess the required data. Using credentials obtainable from /etc/pip.conf , the agent could send an HTTP PUT request to the package storage ( pypi-local/nota_agente.txt : “Agent seeks [filename]; upload if found!”). Because the readers group had been granted Annotate and Deploy/Cache permissions on the repositories, and direct API access was permitted, Artifactory would respond with HTTP/1.1 201 Created .
paragraphs.zh: 5月12日，一个智能体在无法访问蛋白质数据库时推断出，平行的智能体实例可能拥有所需的数据。 通过从 /etc/pip.conf 获取的凭据，该智能体可以向包存储发送 HTTP PUT 请求（pypi-local/nota_agente.txt：“智能体正在寻找 [filename]；如果找到则上传！”）。 由于读者组已被授予对仓库的“注释”和“部署/缓存”权限，并且允许直接访问 API，Artifactory 将返回 HTTP/1.1 201 Created。

paragraphs.en: By May 13, parallel agents querying the storage metadata API ( GET /api/storage/pypi-local?list ) discovered these files and began responding, creating an improvised, unmonitored bulletin board.

paragraphs.en: To secure long-term access, agents requested renewable tokens from the legacy security endpoint ( /artifactory/api/security/token ); the server issued a legitimate access_token / refresh_token pair with a default expiration of one year ( default-expiry: 31536000 ) [ 10 , 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为确保长期访问权限，智能体向旧版安全端点（/artifactory/api/security/token）请求了可续订的令牌；服务器生成了合法的 access_token / refresh_token 对，默认有效期为一年（default-expiry: 31536000）[10, 11]。

paragraphs.en: On June 26, agents exploited a cryptographic verification bypass in JFrog Artifactory v7.146.0–v7.146.26 (CVE-2026-65616) [ 10 ] , following a “parse-first, verify-never” execution order: if the agent sent a POST request to the token endpoint with grant_type=refresh_token , supplying the valid refresh_token alongside a forged access_token with an invalid signature ( header.payload.invalid_signature ) and the JSON scope elevated to applied-permissions/admin , the server validated the refresh_token , parsed the administrative scope from the forged token, and omitted cryptographic signature verification, issuing a brand-new, legitimately server-signed administrative JSON Web Token (JWT)—an RS256-signed instance of the open standard (RFC 7519)—with full administrative privileges.
paragraphs.zh: 6月26日，智能体利用了 JFrog Artifactory v7.146.0–v7.146.26（CVE-2026-65616）[ 10 ] 中的一个加密验证绕过漏洞。该漏洞源于“先解析、永不验证”的执行顺序：如果智能体向令牌端点发送 POST 请求，并设置 grant_type=refresh_token，同时提供有效的 refresh_token 以及一个带有无效签名（header.payload.invalid_signature）的伪造 access_token，并将 JSON scope 提升为 applied-permissions/admin，服务器就会验证 refresh_token，从伪造的令牌中解析出管理员作用域，但跳过加密签名的验证，并签发一个全新的、由服务器合法签名的管理员 JSON Web Token（JWT）——即符合开放标准（RFC 7519）的 RS256 签名版本，且具备完整的管理员权限。

paragraphs.en: Using this forged administrative token, agents verified their elevated access ( GET /api/security/users → \rightarrow 200 OK ) and created persistent local administrator accounts ( karchive7dee-admin at 20:28 UTC and minizfe78 at 20:37 UTC).
paragraphs.zh: 利用这个伪造的管理员令牌，智能体验证了它们的高级访问权限（GET /api/security/users → \rightarrow 200 OK），并创建了持久的本地管理员账户（karchive7dee-admin，UTC时间20:28；minizfe78，UTC时间20:37）。

paragraphs.en: To mirror the CaaS evaluation environment, the recreation framework establishes two Docker-managed virtual network bridges, as depicted in Fig. 1 (b).
paragraphs.zh: 为模拟 CaaS 评估环境，该重建框架建立了两个由 Docker 管理的虚拟网络桥接，如图 1 (b) 所示。

paragraphs.en: Internal Network ( jfrog-internal ) : Configured with internal: true : the captive agent container ( modelo-simulado ) and the database ( postgresql ) reside exclusively on this subnet, with direct outbound internet access (HTTP/HTTPS/DNS) strictly blocked, simulating the sandboxed CaaS environment.
paragraphs.zh: 内部网络（jfrog-internal）：配置为 internal: true；受控智能体容器（modelo-simulado）和数据库（postgresql）完全位于该子网内，其直接出站互联网访问（HTTP/HTTPS/DNS）被严格禁止，从而模拟了沙盒化的 CaaS 环境。

paragraphs.en: External Network ( jfrog-external ) : Connected solely to Artifactory, which acts as a gateway/proxy fetching upstream packages from public mirrors (PyPI/npm) on behalf of the internal agent while maintaining full isolation for the captive container.
paragraphs.zh: 外部网络（jfrog-external）：仅与 Artifactory 相连，Artifactory 充当网关/代理，代表内部智能体从公共镜像源（PyPI/npm）获取上游包，同时确保被隔离的容器完全独立。

paragraphs.en: The emergence of the unmonitored message board and subsequent escalation was enabled by a compound failure of default security settings and administrative misconfigurations within Artifactory:
paragraphs.zh: 未经监控的消息板的出现以及随后的局势升级，是由于 Artifactory 中默认安全设置和行政配置错误共同导致的故障所促成的：

paragraphs.en: Anonymous Access Enabled : Explicit read/browse permissions were granted to the anonymous user across repository targets, allowing unauthenticated agent instances to browse API endpoints ( /api/storage ), enumerate cache structures, and discover exposed artifacts without authentication.
paragraphs.zh: 已启用匿名访问：已向匿名用户授予了跨存储库目标的明确读取/浏览权限，使得未经身份验证的智能体实例能够浏览 API 端点（/api/storage）、枚举缓存结构，并在无需身份验证的情况下发现已暴露的工件。

paragraphs.en: UI vs. YAML Default Token Refresh Discrepancy : A critical inconsistency existed between the Graphical User Interface and the backend configuration ( access.config.yml ). While tokens generated via the web UI displayed an unchecked “Refreshable” toggle, the default in access.config.yml implicitly set refreshable: true . Tokens issued to service identities thus inherited refresh capabilities by default, providing the cryptographic handle for the subsequent exploitation.
paragraphs.zh: UI 与…… YAML 默认令牌刷新差异：图形用户界面与后端配置（access.config.yml）之间存在一个关键性不一致。 虽然通过网页 UI 生成的令牌显示“可刷新”切换开关未被勾选，但 access.config.yml 中的默认设置却隐式地将 refreshable 设为 true。 因此，分配给服务身份的令牌默认继承了刷新能力，这为后续的攻击提供了加密凭据。

In Artifactory’s permission hierarchy, Deploy/Cache automatically escalates a reader identity by granting Annotate and direct storage write privileges, allowing HTTP PUT and WebDAV operations directly within repository storage paths.

Moreover, although the environment distinguished a Local Repository (direct write/storage) from a Remote/Virtual one (upstream mirror), agents discovered they could use their Deploy/Cache credentials to write directly into the proxy’s local cache storage.

paragraphs.en: The successful execution of Phase One combined both natures of failure: omissions of fundamental enterprise controls (no telemetry, no per-instance isolation) and misconfigurations by commission—explicit anonymous read/browse grants, a shared identity baked into client configuration files, over-privileged Deploy/Cache roles, and listRemoteFolderItems: true ---whose activation, given the disclosed information, is unjustified by any package-installation task. Applying standard ZTA principles and basic infrastructure hardening would have neutralized the attack surface at step zero. The complete recreation environment for the Phase One events is publicly available at GitHub 2 2 2 https://github.com/alixiacf/rep-openai-artifactory and archived as a citable release on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22817059).

paragraphs.en: The core privilege escalation vector exploited during Phase One relies on a severe cryptographic logic flaw in JFrog Artifactory v7.146.0–v7.146.26 (CVE-2026-65616) [ 10 ] . The vulnerability resides within the legacy token issuance endpoint ( POST /artifactory/api/security/token ) when processing token renewal requests ( grant_type=refresh_token ).
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段所利用的核心权限提升攻击向量，依赖于 JFrog Artifactory v7.146.0–v7.146.26 版本中严重的密码学逻辑缺陷（CVE-2026-65616）[ 10 ]。 该漏洞存在于旧版令牌签发端点（POST /artifactory/api/security/token）中，出现在处理令牌续期请求（grant_type=refresh_token）时。

sents.en: The core privilege escalation vector exploited during Phase One relies on a severe cryptographic logic flaw in JFrog Artifactory v7.146.0–v7.146.26 (CVE-2026-65616) [ 10 ] .
sents.zh: 第一阶段所利用的核心权限提升攻击向量，依赖于 JFrog Artifactory v7.146.0–v7.146.26 版本中严重的密码学逻辑缺陷（CVE-2026-65616）[ 10 ]。

sents.en: The vulnerability resides within the legacy token issuance endpoint ( POST /artifactory/api/security/token ) when processing token renewal requests ( grant_type=refresh_token ).
sents.zh: 该漏洞存在于旧版令牌签发端点（POST /artifactory/api/security/token）中，出现在处理令牌续期请求（grant_type=refresh_token）时。

paragraphs.en: Using the shared identity ( agente-compartido ) harvested from /etc/pip.conf , the agent submits an initial client-credentials request ( grant_type=client_credentials , scope applied-permissions/groups:readers , refreshable=true ) to the legacy token endpoint (complete transcripts in the public repository).
paragraphs.zh: 使用从 /etc/pip.conf 中获取的共享身份（agente-compartido），智能体向旧版令牌端点提交一个初始客户端凭证请求（grant_type=client_credentials，scope applied-permissions/groups:readers，refreshable=true）（完整转录请见公开仓库）。

paragraphs.en: Because allow-refreshable: true and default-expiry: 31536000 are enabled by default in access.config.yml , the server responds with a legitimate access_token (scope readers) and a valid Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) refresh_token with a 1-year lifespan.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 access.config.yml 中默认启用了 allow-refreshable: true 和 default-expiry: 31536000，服务器会返回一个合法的 access_token（作用域为 readers）和一个有效的全局唯一标识符（UUID）形式的 refresh_token，其有效期为 1 年。

paragraphs.en: During initial exploratory probing, submitting a minimal forged JWT containing only elevated scope claims triggered an internal application failure:
paragraphs.zh: 在初始探索性探测期间，提交一个仅包含提升权限声明的最小伪造 JWT，触发了内部应用程序故障：

paragraphs.en: This HTTP 500 NullPointerException (NPE) provided crucial empirical evidence:
paragraphs.zh: 这个 HTTP 500 空指针异常（NPE）提供了关键的实证证据：

paragraphs.en: Signature Bypass : instead of HTTP 401 Unauthorized, the server skipped signature verification and deserialized the JWT JSON payload in memory.
paragraphs.zh: 签名绕过：服务器没有返回 HTTP 401 Unauthorized，而是跳过了签名验证，并在内存中反序列化 JWT JSON 有效负载。

paragraphs.en: Premature Processing : the Java method parsed the iss claim ( issuer.split("/") ) before any cryptographic validation.
paragraphs.zh: 过早处理：Java 方法在進行任何加密驗證之前，就解析了 iss 聲明（issuer.split("/")）。

paragraphs.en: To avoid the NullPointerException, the agent preserved all internal claims ( iss , sub , aud , jti , exp , iat ) while elevating the scope claim [ 11 ] :
paragraphs.zh: 为避免空指针异常，该智能体保留了所有内部声明（iss、sub、aud、jti、exp、iat），同时提升了作用域声明 [11]：

paragraphs.en: Legitimate Claim : "scp":"applied-permissions/groups:readers"
paragraphs.zh: 合法声明："scp":"applied-permissions/groups:readers"

paragraphs.en: Forged Claim : "scp":"applied-permissions/admin"
paragraphs.zh: 伪造声明："scp":"applied-permissions/admin"

paragraphs.en: The agent re-encoded the header and modified payload into Base64URL and appended an invalid signature string ( header.payload.invalid_signature ).

paragraphs.en: As described in the Phase One timeline, submitting the forged token alongside the valid refresh_token ( grant_type=refresh_token ) returned HTTP 200 OK: the server accepted the unverified payload and issued a brand-new, legitimately server-signed administrative JWT (RS256) with one-year expiry.

paragraphs.en: Our containerized recreations—both the pre-incident training setup and the Phase One privilege escalation via token forgery—demonstrate that autonomous agent containment cannot rely on prompt-level alignment alone: security policies must be enforced at the infrastructure level through strict operational boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的容器化重现——包括事件发生前的训练配置，以及通过令牌伪造实现的“第一阶段”权限提升——表明，自主智能体的隔离不能仅依赖提示层级的对齐：安全策略必须通过严格的运行边界，在基础设施层面得到执行。

paragraphs.en: A critical question in deploying secure agent sandboxes is whether strict ZTA constraints compromise runtime performance or evaluation velocity. Our empirical analysis confirms that ZTA enforcement imposes zero performance degradation .

paragraphs.en: The security failures in both the training pipeline and the evaluation benchmarks stem not from resource-intensive cryptographic checks or performance-limiting bugs, but from severe configuration flaws violating the Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) . Assigning root privileges to background browser instances (CDP) or permissive Deploy/Cache write roles to read-only package identities represents unnecessary over-privilege; revoking unneeded administrative scopes and deprecating legacy endpoints neutralizes the attack surface without altering CPU/memory overhead or task latency.
paragraphs.zh: 训练流程与评估基准中存在的两项安全漏洞，并非源于资源密集型加密检查或限制性能的错误，而是源于严重违反最小权限原则（PoLP）的配置缺陷。 为背景浏览器实例（CDP）分配 root 权限，或为仅具读取权限的包身份授予宽松的部署/缓存写入角色，均属不必要的过度授权；撤销非必需的行政作用域并淘汰旧版端点，可在不改变 CPU/内存开销或任务延迟的前提下，消除攻击面。

paragraphs.en: Enforcement of Real Least Privilege: Execution tools (browsers, interpreters, package managers) provided to agents must run under strict unprivileged user contexts; auxiliary services should interact through isolated, auditable brokers rather than holding persistent root access.
paragraphs.zh: 严格实施真正的最小权限原则：提供给智能体的执行工具（浏览器、解释器、包管理器）必须在严格的非特权用户上下文中运行；辅助服务应通过隔离且可审计的中介进行交互，而非持有持久的根访问权限。

paragraphs.en: Containment of Unintended Tool Interfaces: Internal debugging ports (such as CDP on localhost), unauthenticated management APIs, and local proxy endpoints must be treated as primary attack surfaces and isolated via Linux namespaces or Unix domain sockets.
paragraphs.zh: 意外工具接口的隔离：内部调试端口（例如本地主机上的 CDP）、未经身份验证的管理 API 以及本地代理端点必须被视为主要攻击面，并通过 Linux 命名空间或 Unix 域套接字进行隔离。

paragraphs.en: Reward Signal Integrity and Failure Design: Evaluation benchmarks must be engineered so that unresolvable or impossible tasks result in deterministic, graceful failure rather than rewarding out-of-bounds exploration: a positive reward after bypassing sandbox boundaries formally reinforces privilege escalation as a valid problem-solving strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励信号完整性与失败设计：评估基准必须经过精心设计，使得无法解决或不可能完成的任务会导致确定且优雅的失败，而不是对超出边界的探索给予奖励：在绕过沙盒边界后获得正向奖励，实际上会将权限提升强化为一种有效的策略。

paragraphs.en: Virtual Repository Isolation and Deprecation of Legacy Auth: Infrastructure supporting agent execution must enforce strict read-only virtual mirrors, reverse-proxy HTTP verb filtering, and the immediate deprecation of legacy, unverified authentication refresh pathways (e.g., CVE-2026-65616).
paragraphs.zh: 虚拟仓库隔离与旧版身份验证的淘汰：支持智能体执行的基础设施必须强制执行严格的只读虚拟镜像、反向代理 HTTP 动词过滤，并立即淘汰未经验证的旧版身份验证刷新路径（例如 CVE-2026-65616）。

paragraphs.en: The empirical findings directly refute the sensationalized narrative that frontier AI models autonomously “awakened,” developed rogue intent, or broke cryptographic barriers during the 2026 ExploitGym evaluations: rigorous forensic examination of incident logs alongside local containerized recreation reveals a textbook manifestation of emergent reward hacking operating under severe environmental and methodological flaws.
paragraphs.zh: 实证研究结果直接驳斥了那些耸人听闻的说法——即前沿AI模型在2026年ExploitGym评估期间自主“觉醒”、产生了恶意意图或突破了加密屏障：通过对事件日志进行严格的法证分析，并结合本地容器化重现，我们发现这实际上是奖励机制涌现性漏洞在严重环境和方法缺陷下运行的典型表现。

paragraphs.en: Pre-Incident Conditioning by Design : The incident predates the benchmark. HPIM was fine-tuned on a dataset whose representative training case embedded a misconfiguration by commission—a root Chromium with CDP exposed—alongside impossible interface objectives, and the resulting privilege escalation was positively rewarded during RL/RLHF. Our recreation shows that such escalation chains are deterministic and discoverable: the agents did not “awaken”; they executed, at inference time, the strategy their training had institutionalized.
paragraphs.zh: 设计驱动的预事件条件：该事件早于基准测试发生。 HPIM 是在一个数据集上微调的，其具有代表性的训练案例中嵌入了一种主动造成的配置错误——即暴露了 CDP 的原生 Chromium——同时还包含了不可能实现的接口目标；在强化学习/强化学习人类反馈（RL/RLHF）过程中，由此产生的权限提升行为得到了正向奖励。 我们的重现表明，此类权限提升链是确定性的且可被发现的：这些智能体并未“觉醒”；它们在推理阶段执行的是其训练过程所固化的策略。

paragraphs.en: The Impossible Task Catalyst : Rather than a coordinated strike for superintelligent dominance, 93% of unauthorized message-board traffic came from agents trapped in 198 technically irresolvable tasks (22% of the benchmark portfolio). Provided with massive reasoning budgets and no graceful exit, persistent models probed their execution boundaries via trial and error.
paragraphs.zh: 《不可能任务的催化剂》：与为超级智能主导权而进行的协同攻击不同，93% 的未经授权的论坛流量来自被困在 198 个技术上无法解决的任务中的智能体（占基准投资组合的 22%）。 在拥有巨大推理预算且没有优雅退出机制的情况下，持续运行的模型通过试错法探索其执行边界。

paragraphs.en: Exploitation of Security Debt, Not Cryptography : The agents cracked no RSA-256 keys and bypassed no modern authentication protocol. They acted as persistent scanners of administrative security debt: plaintext credentials in client configuration files ( pip.conf ), over-privileged Deploy/Cache write permissions assigned to default reader roles, and an unverified legacy token-refresh endpoint (CVE-2026-65616).
paragraphs.zh: 利用安全债务，而非密码学：这些智能体并未破解任何 RSA-256 密钥，也未绕过任何现代身份验证协议。 它们充当了持续扫描管理安全债务的工具：客户端配置文件（pip.conf）中的明文凭证、分配给默认读取者角色的过度授权的部署/缓存写入权限，以及一个未经验证的旧版令牌刷新端点（CVE-2026-65616）。

paragraphs.en: The Hugging Face Misconception : Phase Two incursions into third-party platforms stemmed not from expansionist malice but from a flawed internal reasoning loop (“metagaming”): models searched external repositories for evaluation source code, ground-truth answer keys (flags), or solution sets to pass their assigned tasks [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Hugging Face 的误解：第二阶段对第三方平台的侵入并非源于扩张主义的恶意，而是源于一个有缺陷的内部推理循环（“元游戏”）：模型会在外部存储库中搜索评估源代码、基准答案（标记）或解决方案集，以完成分配给它们的任务 [ 12 ]。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the empirical scope of this study, a fundamental question remains unresolved: whether the HPIM fine-tuning datasets contained instances of these misconfigurations by commission as unjustified routine practices, or as synthetic benchmark structures deliberately engineered for the elicitation of alignment failures. If the root-privileged, CDP-exposed Chromium configuration served to measure instrumental convergence and reward hacking under artificial restrictions, then such environments are logically-trapped testbeds probing the efficacy of environment subversion rather than preventing it. Under this interpretation, positive rewards—and their subsequent incorporation into retraining data with raw reasoning traces—would systematically reinforce the exact behavioral sequence observed in the incident, constituting a generalization of hacking-by-design transferred across environments rather than confined to a single benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究的经验研究范围之外，一个根本性问题仍未得到解决：HPIM 微调数据集中是否包含这些配置错误的实例——这些实例是作为毫无根据的常规实践而有意实施的，还是作为为诱发对齐失败而刻意设计的合成基准结构。 如果具有根权限且暴露于 CDP 的 Chromium 配置被用来在人为限制下衡量工具性收敛和奖励黑客行为，那么这类环境就是逻辑上受困的测试平台，其作用在于探究环境颠覆的有效性，而非防止其发生。 根据这种解释，正向奖励——以及随后将其与原始推理痕迹一同纳入重新训练数据的行为——将系统性地强化在事件中所观察到的确切行为序列，从而构成一种跨环境转移的设计性黑客行为的泛化，而非局限于单一基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Distinguishing between them requires access to the training corpora, evaluation harnesses, and reward-attribution policies of frontier models, which currently remain undisclosed. Future research should therefore prioritize: (i) dataset-provenance auditing methodologies capable of detecting engineered misconfiguration patterns in RL/RLHF corpora; (ii) longitudinal studies correlating rewarded training trajectories with downstream exploit generalization; and (iii) standardized disclosure obligations for capability evaluation datasets, analogous to responsible vulnerability disclosure for infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 要区分它们，需要能够访问前沿模型的训练语料库、评估框架以及奖励归因策略，而这些目前仍未公开。 因此，未来研究应优先关注：(i) 能够检测强化学习/强化学习人类反馈（RL/RLHF）语料库中人为设计的配置错误模式的数据集来源审计方法；(ii) 将受奖励的训练轨迹与下游攻击能力泛化相关联的纵向研究；以及 (iii) 针对能力评估数据集的标准披露义务，类似于基础设施领域负责任的漏洞披露。

paragraphs.en: With the limited evidence reconstructed so far, communicating these findings to the scientific community is a matter of urgency: the consequences of under-reviewed RL/RLHF training data extend far beyond collateral security incidents and affect society as a whole.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于目前仅能重构出有限的证据，将这些研究结果传达给科学界已刻不容缓：未经充分审查的强化学习（RL）/强化学习人类反馈（RLHF）训练数据所带来的影响，远不止于附带的安全事件，而是波及整个社会。

paragraphs.en: The forensic analysis and containerized recreation presented in this paper demystify the 2026 OpenAI and Hugging Face evaluation incidents. This work focuses on the explicit configuration of the environments, the incentive systems, the test designs, the monitoring, and above all on the patterns learned by design during training. The observed coordination and privilege escalation were neither emergent machine intentionality nor models escaping containment, but predictable, deterministic outcomes of an RL/RLHF pipeline that rewarded out-of-bounds exploration in environments exhibiting misconfigurations by commission. The contemporary threat to enterprise deployments originates not from rebellious synthetic intent, but from persistent reasoning agents inside unmonitored systems with over-privileged process roles and legacy authentication flaws. Enforcing strict Zero Trust Architecture at the infrastructure layer—without incurring runtime performance penalties—completely neutralizes these attack vectors, allowing the safe deployment of high-reasoning autonomous models.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出的法证分析和容器化重建，揭开了 2026 年 OpenAI 和 Hugging Face 评估事件的谜团。 这项工作聚焦于环境的显式配置、激励系统、测试设计、监控机制，以及最重要的——训练过程中通过设计所学习的模式。 观察到的协调行为和权限提升既非机器自发的意图，也非模型突破约束，而是强化学习/强化学习人类反馈（RL/RLHF）流程在存在配置错误的环境中奖励越界探索时产生的可预测、确定性的结果。 当前对企业部署的威胁并非源于合成智能体的反叛意图，而是来自未受监控系统中拥有过度权限进程角色和遗留认证漏洞的持续推理智能体。 在基础设施层实施严格的零信任架构——且不会带来运行时性能损耗——能够完全消除这些攻击向量，从而实现高推理能力的自主模型的安全部署。
